candidates.gap: Kimi Desktop has skills but no tools
candidates.evidence: 3 of 4 vendor packages declaring mcpServers use the url form (cloudflare, github, supabase). Pack servers surreal-memory (HTTP 200), prometheus-knowledge (HTTP 405 = listener up) are already HTTP MCP endpoints in .mcp.json.
candidates.rationale: No shim, no PATH coupling, no binary shipped into app-managed state.

candidates.evidence: kimi-cu/bin/kimi-cu-mcp is a POSIX shim whose header states kimi-code only accepts a PATH command or ./ relative path, and forwards to an absolute app path.
candidates.rationale: Sanctioned fallback, proven by vendor precedent, but unnecessary while the url form covers the local HTTP servers.

candidates.gap: no orientation discipline on Kimi Desktop
candidates.evidence: sessionStart shape is {"skill": "<name>"} per the github package; kbd-status confirmed present in the 145 installed skills.
candidates.rationale: Matches the SessionStart hook discipline the other harnesses get.

candidates.evidence: .mcp.json declares both via npx; they are third-party services requiring their own credentials.
candidates.rationale: Not the pack's to redistribute; shipping them makes our package responsible for third-party auth.

candidates.evidence: Pack binaries total hundreds of MB; the generation payload was already cut 188M -> 98M for exactly this reason (commit 67d29a2).
candidates.rationale: Would duplicate large binaries into app-managed state that the vendor may prune.

blocked.reason: Endpoint returned HTTP 401. The vendor url schema in installed packages shows no auth-header field, so a bearer-token server may be unusable from Kimi Desktop.
